institution: IIIT Bhopal (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Bhopal)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: 2024 data shows highest package of 34.4 LPA and average CSE package of 14.7 LPA; top recruiters include Amazon, Intuit, Nvidia, and Qualcomm; placements described as steadily improving each year.
Strong coding culture with regular contests; supportive faculty (about 80% from mentoring institute MANIT); industry-oriented curriculum contributing to good placement outcomes, especially in CSE/IT.

College runs on MANIT Bhopal's lush green ~600-acre campus; wifi available campus-wide; vehicles allowed on campus; labs well-equipped with updated systems; transport (bus) facilities and cafeteria options (including MANIT Cafeteria and Nescafe stalls) available.
Many students land roles in product-based companies, reflecting a strong technical/coding skill emphasis.

key_negative_themes.notes: Lowest-rated category (3.1/5); classes run in MANIT's shared campus with no permanent, independent IIIT Bhopal campus yet.
Hostels are located off-campus and described as average; distance between hostels and academic buildings reduces student involvement in campus activities.
Described as 'balanced but not very vibrant' due to the temporary MANIT setup; fests, clubs, and coding events are active but limited by shared facilities.
Fees considered relatively high for a newer, still-developing institute; value for money rated as moderate rather than excellent.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Good academics and placements but avg infrastructure — classes run in MANIT's campus, hostels off-campus and average, no permanent campus yet
Excellent placement record, especially in the IT sector — highest package 34.4 LPA in 2024, average CSE package 14.7 LPA, recruiters Amazon, Intuit, Nvidia, Qualcomm
Lack of an independent campus impacts student life; limited extracurricular and campus activities due to temporary setup
This is newly established IIIT, classes conducted in MANIT, lab equipment also used from MANIT, hostel facility for boys only in 1st year

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Bhopal is moderately positive, driven by steadily improving placements with strong recruiters like Amazon, Nvidia, and Qualcomm, alongside a solid coding culture and industry-relevant curriculum. The institute's clearest weakness is its continued lack of an independent campus, operating instead from MANIT Bhopal's shared facilities with off-campus hostels — a pattern common among several newer-generation IIITs — which dampens overall campus life and infrastructure sentiment.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
